## Background

<!-- CHANGE THIS -->

I am currently pursuing a Master of City Planning at the University of Pennsylvania. Before coming to Penn, I graduated from Oberlin College with a BA in Environmental Studies and worked for the City of Stamford in their Operations Department. I am passionate about urban sustainability and issues relating to green energy systems, public transit, and food accessibility. It is my intention to work towards a career where I can help empower communities to feel resilient and connected in the face of climate change.
